 EXO-KASE to bring 'Silent City' 2027 Fancon Tour to Manila
 By Aimee Anoc 
 Published November 13, 2026 6:34 PM PHT

 Showbiz News 
 EXO-KASE has announced its first fan concert tour, "Silent City," which includes a stop in Manila.
 EXO's newest unit, EXO-KASE, composed of members Kai and Sehun, is set to visit the Philippines as part of their upcoming "Silent City" fan concert tour in 2027.
 Based on information posted on @weareoneEXO on Friday (November 13), EXO-KASE will visit eight cities for their first fancon tour, including Manila.
 The Manila leg is scheduled for March 21, 2027, at the Araneta Coliseum.
 The tour will kick off in Seoul on January 9 and 10, followed by Kuala Lumpur (January 16), Macau (January 23 and 24), Jakarta (January 30), Tokyo (February 4 and 5), Bangkok (February 13 and 14), Taipei (February 20), and Manila (March 21).

— EXO (@weareoneEXO) November 13, 2026 
 Ticket prices and seat plan have yet to be announced. The Manila stop will be handled by local concert organizer, PULP Live Word.
 EXO-KASE is set to debut on December 1 with its first mini album, Waking Up The City.
